title: Deprotonation- and TICT-triggered ultra-large Stokes shift of aqueous NIR-emissive hydroxylstryryl-pyridinium derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19620-19625
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02237E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xiaolong Lu, Liyu Xiong, Zhihan Zhang, Haolong Yang, Enmin Li, Hefeng Zhang
An ultra-large Stokes shift of up to 404 nm was accomplished in hydroxystyryl-pyridinium derivatives through the combined effects of excited-state phenol deprotonation and twisted intramolecular charge transfer (TICT).
